name: mFlash AI SEO Optimizer
author: mflash1233

sections.description:
mFlash AI SEO Optimizer is a comprehensive SEO plugin that helps you optimize your WordPress content for better search engine rankings. The plugin provides AI-powered optimization through an external service.

Key Features:

  • AI-Powered Optimization: Optional integration with AI service for enhanced content optimization
  • Real-time Analysis: Get instant feedback on your SEO improvements
  • Meta Tag Management: Optimize titles, descriptions, and keywords
  • Content Analysis: Comprehensive analysis of content quality and structure

What makes this plugin different:

  • Privacy First: All external API usage requires explicit user consent
  • User-Friendly: Clean, intuitive interface that doesn’t overwhelm
  • Performance Optimized: Minimal impact on site performance

External Service Integration:

This plugin can connect to our AI service to provide enhanced SEO analysis and content optimization. The plugin provides full SEO scoring.

Data sent to external service (only with user consent):
* Post content and titles for AI analysis
* Your website URL for authentication
* SEO meta data for optimization suggestions
sections.faq:
What data is sent to the external service?

Only with your explicit consent, the plugin may send post content, titles, and SEO meta data to our AI service for analysis. No personal information or user data is transmitted.

Is the plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes! The plugin follows privacy-first principles and requires explicit consent before connecting to any external services.

How does the SEO scoring work?

The plugin analyzes various SEO factors including title optimization, meta descriptions, content length, keyword usage, image alt tags, internal linking, and more.
